description: Automate any Android device UI over adb using uiautomator screen dumps and coordinate-based input. Use this skill whenever a task requires interacting with an Android app's UI (tapping buttons, navigating menus, scrolling lists, reading on-screen state, verifying verdicts/dialogs) on an emulator, redroid container, or physical device reachable via `adb`. Covers the dump → parse → locate → tap → verify loop, multi-instance serial hygiene, bottom-sheet and scroll-list navigation, and Windows/PowerShell host pitfalls.
